voices.note: anonymous redactorial voice of this unit
the mishna on hanging limbs and flesh, as cited here (129a.14-16, 129b.4, 129b.8)
the Sages of the fig-branch text, disputing R' Yehuda

props.gloss_en: the mishna: [the animal died...] and R' Shimon deems [it] pure
the stam: R' Shimon stands on the first clause
the mishna: the limb and the flesh hanging in an animal impart food impurity in their place, and need hechsher
the mishna: and R' Shimon deems [the hanging limb and flesh in a living animal] pure
R' Yochanan: the verse says 'of all food which may be eaten' -- food you can feed to others is called food; food you cannot feed to others is not called food
R' Zeira: perhaps R' Shimon's reason there is: since it is attached, it is attached
a fig branch that broke off and is attached by the bark -- R' Yehuda deems [it] pure
and the Sages say: if it can live -- pure; and if not -- impure
[R' Zeira:] we asked you R' Yehuda's reason and you told us: since it is attached, it is attached
R' Asi: [R' Yochanan's reason was said] on the middle clause
the mishna: the animal was slaughtered -- [the limb and flesh] were made susceptible by its blood; the words of R' Meir
R' Shimon says: they were not made susceptible
the stam: rather, actually [R' Shimon is] on the last clause -- and not on the limb but on the flesh
the mishna: the animal died -- the [hanging] flesh needs hechsher
and R' Shimon deems [the hanging flesh of the animal that died] pure

schemas.gloss_en: מה נפשך: if death makes [the hanging limb] fallen, let it be impure as a limb from the living; if death does not make it fallen, let it be impure as a limb from a carcass -- either way it is impure, so how can R' Shimon deem it pure?

grounds.gloss_en: רבי שמעון ארישא קאי -- R' Shimon's 'pure' is on the first clause, the hanging limb and flesh of a living animal (= p_arisha_kaei); abandoned at 129b.8 (אלא לעולם אסיפא)
לעולם אסיפא, ולאו אאבר אלא אבשר -- R' Shimon's 'pure' is on the last clause but on the FLESH, not the limb, so the dilemma about the limb does not reach him (= p_asefa_abasar)

supports.gloss_en: מאי טעמא דרבי שמעון? אמר קרא מכל האכל אשר יאכל -- the hanging limb and flesh are not food for impurity

deflected_by.gloss_en: דילמא טעמא דרבי שמעון התם הואיל ומעורה מעורה -- perhaps R' Shimon's reason in the first clause is that what is attached counts as attached (= p_zeira_hoil_umeure)
